Performers
New Comma Baroque (ensemble), Matthew C. Cataldi (Baroque violin), Leighann Daihl (Baroque flute), Phillip W. Serna (viola da gamba), Emily J. Morlan (historical keyboards) Documented[1]
Work version
Trio-sonata performance with Baroque violin, Baroque flute, viola da gamba and historical keyboards; estimated pitch approximately A = 415 Hz Inferred, not documented

The instrumentation is documented on Commons. The pitch is an editorial inference from the semitone offset between the score and the project’s machine analysis (cache/analysis/couperin-nations-piemontaise.txt, opening pitch-class windows). It is not stated by the performers and has not been checked by ear; the performing edition is unidentified.
